# Specter Decision Engine

> Specter Decision Engine is a Python 3.11+ framework for bounded typed numeric decisions. Current prerelease: v0.2.0rc5. It includes local System-One backend code, explicit failure states, OpenAPI integration, amortized prefill caching, and an optional native C prefill path.

Use the pinned installation brief for installation tasks. A successful package doctor check verifies installation only; it does not prove domain accuracy, calibration quality, benchmark reproducibility, or production readiness. License selection remains pending.

## Installation

- [Pinned rc5 install brief](./llms-install.txt): Exact wheel, SHA-256, virtual-environment rules, verification steps, and scope constraints for humans or agents.
- [Official v0.2.0rc5 release](https://github.com/aigodsend9-boop/specter-decision-engine/releases/tag/v0.2.0rc5): Published release metadata and assets.

- [Source repository](https://github.com/aigodsend9-boop/specter-decision-engine): Project source and history.
